spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates what the width descriptor family is for: a real wdth axis driven through the high-level property, registered via the constructor with the new width member plus the stretch alias, with the low-level font-variation-settings comparison the spec distinguishes.

interactive.rationale: A native range slider drives the axis 50–200% with live specimen rendering, measured text advances, and computed-style read-backs.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the slider, the fontTools-built axis font, the property fallback, and measured advances — all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles font-load failure by disabling the slider with an explicit error (never simulating), labels the font-stretch fallback path as a fallback, and reports the absent width attribute honestly in the face read-back.

references.rationale: Links CSS Fonts 4 font-width and both sibling concepts; the feature index carries the ChromeStatus link.

conformance.rationale: The suite's stretch-percentage-drives-wdth-axis assertion pins this page's core claim with a measured 2× ratio check against the same built font; it passes here (ratio 2.0 observed).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP driver run 2026-08-16 after the measurement-span fix (f2-stage.png): sub-line advance 172px at 50% → 690px at 200% (exactly 4×), fvs line 154→617px, computed font-stretch tracked the slider; screenshot read shows the pixel specimen rendering wide at 200%; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts width-stage-font-loaded on the real load outcome (separate failure branch when the font cannot load).

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the specimen sits black-on-ivory; the mechanism note is charcoal-on-stone (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Native range input labelled with the live percentage, aria-describedby to the mechanism note, aria-live mechanism updates, and the wide specimen is a focusable scroll region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the specimen clamps its font-size and scrolls internally at 200% width on 360px screens.

openQuestions.title: Verify the font-width property path on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On this Chromium 141 the stage correctly falls back to font-stretch (labelled). On a 153 build, confirm the mechanism note switches to font-width, the computed font-width read-back is non-empty, and the width constructor member read-back appears in the face panel.

guidanceConsulted.query: loading font asset FontFace variable font rendering typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Declare an explicit fallback stack and avoid layout surprises while a custom font loads.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The specimen stacks the demo font over var(--font-mono), waits for document.fonts.ready before measuring, and the pixel font is a data URI so there is no network swap flash.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive wide content stage slider layout mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let intrinsically wide content scroll inside its own container and size controls with relative units.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The specimen box is overflow-x:auto with clamp()ed font-size; the slider is inline-size:100% with a 44px hit area.

summary: A real wdth-axis variable font (built with fontTools because system fonts cannot be relied on to carry the axis, and honestly labelled as such) driven by the width/stretch property pair with measured advances: 4× advance range verified live, fallback labelled, failure state explicit.
